title: Chapter 245 Alchemy Competition
content:
Chapter 245 Alchemy Competition

"You are Jordan Yang."

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke.

Upon hearing this, Jordanyang nodded, "It's me, Lord of the Wilderness. I have been looking for you from the Immortal Realm all the time."

Speaking of this, a resentful expression suddenly appeared on Jordanyang's face.

He came over from afar and was beaten up.

"Lord Huang City, do you really want to give me some explanation?"

Seeing Lu Daosheng laughing but not speaking, Jordan Yang immediately continued to say something indignantly.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng sneered, "What, why, why would I beat you up in person?"

As soon as he finished speaking, a terrifying aura slowly overflowed from Lu Daosheng's body.

At this moment, the city lord's mansion, which was as stable as Mount Tai, began to tremble.

Obviously, he could not bear Lu Daosheng's breath at all.

Seeing this, Jordan Yang's face turned pale.

"Then what, I'm just talking, just talking."

Seeing that Lu Daosheng was not reasonable at all, Jordanyang quickly admitted his defeat.

To reason with such a strong man, there is no difference between seeking death.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng snorted coldly.

"It's about the same."

Jordanyang wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and felt extremely sad.

It's so terrifying!

Unexpectedly, this small wooden fairy world is actually a crouching tiger and hidden dragon.

Although most of my cultivation is taken by taking drugs, I am also a real peak-level strongman in the Immortal Emperor Realm.

It would be fine if there are powerful people in the Wood Immortal Realm who can beat them up, but there are actually terrifying existences above the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Is it still alive?

"Lord Huang City, when I see you today, I have no regrets. I still have something to do in the academy, so I will say goodbye first."

As he said that, Jordanyang wanted to escape.

However, as soon as he turned around, he was stopped by Lu Daosheng.

"stop!"

Suddenly, Jordanyang trembled all over and turned around and smiled bitterly: "Right, is there anything else?"

Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "You are also a famous alchemist after all."

"It's only been so long since I came to my deserted city, and I just left like that."

"You can't come to my wasteland city, it's impossible for you to have no purpose, right?"

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Jordanyang smiled and burst into tears in his heart. It was indeed a purpose for him to come to Huangcheng.

But my purpose is to come to you to learn about the alchemy, and you can also learn it by the way.

If you have strong enough elixir skills, you can let go and ask for advice humbly.

But now, everything is a misunderstanding.

It was my mistake.

but,,

Jordan Yang carefully glanced behind Lu Daosheng, and Shi Liantian, who had been silent, had some guesses in his heart.

This person must be an alchemist with extremely strong attainments in alchemy.

It is also very likely that Lu Xue’s pill was refined by this person.

Thinking of this, Jordanyang hesitated again.

Do you want to speak up yourself?

However, the pain on his face made him dispel this idea.

He really didn't want to stay in this place for a moment.

"That, Lord Huangcheng, I came here to be curious about where Lu Xue once lived, that's all."

Jordan Yang lowered his head slightly and said guiltily.

I want to leave here as soon as possible.

But when he heard this, Lu Daosheng still had a smile on his face.

"Is that so? Then after reading it now, do you have no idea?"

Upon hearing this, Jordan Yang shook his head like a rattle, "No, no."

"No, that's a pity."

Seeing Lu Daosheng sighing, Jordan Yang felt relieved.

Finally can go back.

But the next moment, Lu Daosheng smiled again and said, "But it doesn't matter, I have it."

As he said that, Lu Daosheng made a small move to the side.

Immediately afterwards, under Lu Daosheng's instructions, Shi Liantian slowly stepped out in front of him.

"I'll introduce you to you. This is an alchemist from my wasteland city."

Immediately, Wan Feng, who had been watching the show on the side, also looked at Shi Liantian curiously.

From the one that Lu Daosheng had just returned, Wan Feng noticed Shi Liantian who had been standing behind Lu Daosheng.

But this person did not speak, and Lu Daosheng didn't say anything.

That's why Wan Feng didn't ask.

Now, when she learned that this was an alchemist in Huangcheng, she was shocked and puzzled.

Alchemist?

Right.

There seemed to be no decent alchemist before Huangcheng.

I didn't pay attention before.

But, where did the elixirs Lu Daosheng come from?

Could it be that Lu Daosheng bought it?

Wan Feng was confused.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at Jordanyang with a solemn face and said, "Master Qiao, I heard that you are also a well-known alchemy master in the Immortal Realm. Why? I wish to give you a look at the alchemist in my deserted city. Something? ”

The three words "Master Qiao" were bitten very hard by Lu Daosheng, which obviously had a little joking meaning.

Hearing this, Jordanyang looked a little hesitant.

He always felt that Lu Daosheng had nothing to do.

Seeing Jordanyang hesitating, Lu Daosheng immediately sneered: "You don't dislike our small place, don't want to compete, right?"

Upon hearing this, Jordanyang trembled all over.

Threat, a naked threat.

At this moment, Jordanyang shouted in his heart that he would never come to this place again!

But the surface still smiled and said, "How could that be? Comparing, it's not OK."

After a moment.

Wanfeng took Jordanyang away from the city lord's mansion and began to prepare for the matter.

"Three days later?"

Although Wan Feng was confused about Lu Daosheng's explanation, he still told Jordanyang truthfully.

"Mr. Qiao, our city lord said that the competition will be held in three days."

As he said that, Wan Feng said with a kind look on his face: "You are also a famous alchemy master in the Immortal Realm. We naturally won't let the competition be so casual, so it will take some time."

Hearing this, Jordan Yang's face changed.

"Three days?!"

"My time is very precious. I have classes in the academy,"

Before he finished speaking, Jordanyang came to an abrupt end, just because Wan Feng had already raised his small circle with a smile.

The meaning is self-evident.

Seeing this, Jordan Yang coughed lightly and said, "In three days, I'm pretty idle anyway."

"Oh, yes, that's great."

"Master Qiao, my deserted city is still very big. In the past two days, you can experience the customs and customs of my deserted city more when you have time."

Immediately, Wanfeng arranged a residence for Jordanyang and left here.

Standing there, Jordanyang sighed heavily.

I accidentally entered the wolf's den.

As the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm, although his strength may be as strong as an ordinary peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm, as an alchemist, his perception must be top-notch.

At this moment, he could clearly feel how many pairs of eyes were staring at him in the dark.

I'm afraid that as soon as I left, I was caught back.

"Forget it, it's just a competition? What's the point of being afraid of?"

Jordan Yang comforted himself.
